beats.event: Rostam loses his horse Rakhsh, hunts alone in Samangan
Welcomed as guest by the king of Samangan
Princess Tahmina declares her love; they marry that night
Rostam departs, leaving a seal to identify any future son
Sohrab is born; Tahmina hides the father's identity from him
Sohrab grows into the greatest warrior in the Turanian army
Sohrab leads an army against Iran, hoping to install Rostam
Rostam and Sohrab meet on the battlefield, neither knowing
In the first duel, Sohrab pins the exhausted Rostam
Rostam tricks Sohrab with the 'two falls' custom and is spared
Rostam prays to Yazdan for renewed strength
In the second duel Rostam breaks Sohrab's back and stabs him
Dying Sohrab reveals the arm-seal; Rostam knows his son
The antidote arrives too late; Sohrab dies in his father's arms
Tahmina burns Sohrab's house and dies of grief
